title: The Experience Paradox
hook: Stop trying to "gain experience" to get the job you want.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side—a person studying a textbook. Right side—a person solving a real-world problem.)
Narrator: Most professionals believe experience is a linear timeline. You work for 3 years, you get 3 years of experience. 
(Visual: Text overlay: 1 Year x 3 = 3 Years Experience)
Narrator: This is a mathematical error. 
(Visual: Text changes to: 1 Year x 1 x 3 = 3 Years of the SAME year.)
Narrator: If you solve the same problem every day for a decade, you don’t have 10 years of experience. You have one year of experience, repeated ten times.
(Visual: Cut to a close-up of the speaker)
Narrator: Companies don't pay for your tenure; they pay for the complexity of the problems you can solve. Stop counting years. Start counting the variety of crises you've managed.
caption: Tenure is a vanity metric. Skill is a utility metric. Are you growing, or are you just repeating? #RationalThoughts #CareerStrategy #FirstPrinciples #CorporateIndia
